english.title: Conspire to possess / control identity documents with intent
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

to possess or control an identity document

(E)_[that was false and that you knew or believed was false,]_
(F)_[that was improperly obtained and that you knew or believed to have been improperly obtained,]_
(G)_[that related to someone else,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE IDENTITY DOCUMENT..), with the intention of

(H)_[using the document to establish personal information about you]_
(I)_[allowing or inducing another, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OTHER PERSON..), to use the document to establish, ascertain or verify personal information about you]_
(J)_[allowing or inducing another namely **(..SPECIFY THE OTHER PERSON..) to use the document to establish, ascertain or verify personal information about **(..SPECIFY THE THIRD PERSON..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
conspired with other / another
to possess / control an identity document
that you knew / believed was false OR
that was improperly obtained and that you knew / believed to have been improperly obtained OR
that relates to someone else
with the intention of
using the document to establish personal information about you OR
allowing / inducing another to use the document to
establish / ascertain / verify personal information about you OR
allowing / inducing another to use the document to
establish / ascertain / verify personal information about a third person

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The reference to the offender or anyone else does not include, in the case of a document within option (C) the individual to whom it relates.
